issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: AdAnt AI
products.tagline: Claude for viral, high-converting social ads
products.summaryZh: Claude，用于打造病毒式传播、高转化率的社交媒体广告
products.descriptionZh: AdAnt AI是一个由创意代理组成的团队，负责社交广告策略、创作与迭代。基于创始团队曾实现5000万+自然浏览量并将付费获客成本平均降低60%的策略，AdAnt AI为TikTok、Instagram和YouTube制作吸睛且高转化的广告。
products.description: AdAnt AI is a team of Creative Agents that handles Social Ad Strategy, Creation, and Iteration. Built on the strategies our founding team used to generate 50M+ Organic Views and reduce Paid Acquisition Costs by 60% on average, AdAnt AI creates Scroll-Stopping, High-Converting Ads for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

products.name: Wispr Flow Notetaker
products.tagline: Meeting notes that get the details right.
products.summaryZh: 会议记录，细节精准无误。
products.descriptionZh: 你的后续跟进效果，取决于会议记录的质量。Wispr Notetaker 能准确捕捉你的话语和发言者信息，让你的总结、跟进和答复同样精准。会议开始前，它会检查邀请函，确保姓名拼写正确，并将你已教给 Wispr Flow 的术语带入每场对话。你的转录稿使用真实姓名，而非“发言者1”和“发言者2”，且每场会议都可通过 MCP 直接导入 Claude 或 ChatGPT。适用于 Mac，免费试用。
products.description: Your follow-ups are only as good as your meeting notes. Wispr Notetaker gets your words and your speakers right, so your recaps, follow-ups, and answers are too. Before the meeting starts, it checks the invite so names are spelled correctly, and it brings the terminology you've already taught Wispr Flow into every conversation. Your transcripts use real names instead of "Speaker 1" and "Speaker 2," and every meeting is ready to pull into Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Available on Mac. Free to try.

products.name: ngrok AI Gateway
products.tagline: One private gateway for every AI model
products.summaryZh: 每个AI模型一个专属网关
products.descriptionZh: ngrok AI Gateway为所有模型提供一个托管网关：公共提供商、自定义端点以及您自行运行的模型。使用一个密钥和一个URL即可在OpenAI、Anthropic和自托管模型之间路由，内置可观测性、访问控制和回退机制。您的私有模型通过ngrok网络连接，因此它们与托管提供商并列，而不会暴露于公共互联网。
products.description: ngrok AI Gateway provides one hosted gateway for every model: public providers, custom endpoints, and the models you run yourself. Use one key and one URL to route across OpenAI, Anthropic, and self-hosted models with observability, access control, and fallbacks built in. Your private models connect through ngrok’s network, so they sit beside hosted providers without being exposed to the public internet.

products.name: Cloudflare Wallets
products.tagline: the programmable wallet for the agentic Internet
products.summaryZh: 面向代理互联网的可编程钱包
products.descriptionZh: Cloudflare Wallets为代理型互联网引入了一个可编程钱包层。它面向未来AI代理能够自主发现、使用并支付服务的场景而构建，为代理提供了一种安全的方式，与API、内容和数字服务进行交易。通过虚拟钱包、消费控制及面向机器的支付方式，Cloudflare正在为下一代AI应用构建金融基础设施。
products.description: Cloudflare Wallets introduces a programmable wallet layer for the agentic Internet. Built for the future where AI agents can discover, use, and pay for services autonomously, it gives agents a secure way to transact with APIs, content, and digital services. With virtual wallets, spending controls, and machine-friendly payments, Cloudflare is building the financial infrastructure for the next generation of AI applications.

products.name: Kiro Crew
products.tagline: Open source agentic development workspace
products.summaryZh: 开源智能体开发工作空间
products.descriptionZh: Kiro Crew是一个持久化工作空间，能跨会话记住你的上下文、经验教训和技能，让你回到进度而非冷启动。构建一个代理团队，在你已使用的工具间协作，并封装在专为重复性工作设计的应用中。
products.description: Kiro Crew is a persistent workspace that remembers your context, lessons, and skills across sessions, so you come back to progress instead of a cold start. Build a crew of agents that work across the tools you already use, wrapped in purpose-built Apps for the jobs you repeat.

products.name: Keystroke
products.tagline: Build powerful AI agents & workflows
products.summaryZh: 构建强大的AI智能体与工作流
products.descriptionZh: Keystroke是一个用于构建强大AI代理的一体化平台。描述你需要的代理，Keystroke会构建它、连接你的工具、进行测试，并将其部署到共享工作区。为代理赋予记忆、工作流、触发器、审批功能，并接入1000多个集成。开源，获YC支持，免费试用并提供20美元额度。
products.description: Keystroke is an all-in-one platform for building powerful AI agents. Describe the agent you need, and Keystroke builds it, connects your tools, tests it, and deploys it to a shared workspace. Give agents memory, workflows, triggers, approvals, and access to 1,000+ integrations. Open source, YC-backed, and free to try with $20 in credits.

products.name: BackEngine MCP
products.tagline: Make private company knowledge usable for AI
products.summaryZh: 让私有企业知识可供AI使用
products.descriptionZh: 大多数公司通过单一的MCP将Claude或ChatGPT接入Slack、邮件、通话、工单及CRM系统。这相当于向分散的系统直接铺设管道，模型仅读取片段便猜测其余内容。BackEngine MCP同样连接这些工具，但会先读取全部信息，将每个账户的所有数据整合为一份带权限的完整记录，并保持实时更新，使Claude和ChatGPT始终基于全局视图工作。对比直接连接器：错误减少67%，关键事实多2.4倍，令牌消耗减少65%。
products.description: Most companies wire Claude or ChatGPT into Slack, email, calls, tickets, and their CRM over one singular MCP. That's raw pipes into scattered systems. The model reads a slice and guesses at the rest. BackEngine MCP connects to the same tools, but reads everything first, joins all of it into one permissioned record per account, kept current, so Claude and ChatGPT always work from the whole picture. Head-to-head: 67% fewer errors, 2.4x more key facts, 65% fewer tokens vs. direct connectors.

products.name: Capacity Desktop
products.tagline: A free Lovable that lives on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 一款免费且常驻Mac的Lovable
products.descriptionZh: 一款Mac应用，将纯英文转化为真实应用——构建并存储在你的机器上，而非他人的服务器。你的代码，你的GitHub，你的AI成本可控。无加价积分，无锁定。免费，无需注册。支持macOS（Apple Silicon），Windows版正在规划中。
products.description: A Mac app that turns plain English into real apps — built and stored on your machine, not someone else's servers. Your code, your GitHub, your own AI at cost. No marked-up credits, no lock-in. Free, no sign-up. macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows on the roadmap.

products.name: Dover MCP
products.tagline: Run your hiring process from Claude or ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 在Claude或ChatGPT中运行你的招聘流程
products.descriptionZh: Dover的MCP将Dover的免费ATS连接到ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor及其他AI工具。现在，您可以使用强大的AI工具来审阅申请人、安排面试、推进候选人流程、添加备注并协调招聘。访问安全，并尊重您团队的现有权限。即日起，作为Dover为初创企业提供的免费ATS的一部分，该功能已可用。
products.description: Dover’s MCP connects Dover’s free ATS to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other AI tools. You can now use powerful AI tools to review applicants, schedule interviews, move candidates through your pipeline, add notes, and coordinate hiring. Access is secure and respects your team's existing permissions. Available today as part of Dover's free ATS for startups.

products.name: StepGrab
products.tagline: Turn any Mac task into a step-by-step guide
products.summaryZh: 将任何Mac任务转化为分步指南
products.descriptionZh: 记录工作流程意味着截图、裁剪、箭头和逐条输入每个步骤。StepGrab 替你完成这一切：点击录制，执行一次任务，每次点击都会以带注释的截图形式返回，步骤说明也已写好。原生 Mac 菜单栏应用，设备端处理，无需账户，不上传任何内容。可导出为 GIF、PDF、MP4、可点击 HTML、Markdown 或竖版视频——一次录制，使用你的品牌色。免费版真实可用。Pro 版每月 $2.99，每年 $12.99，或一次性 $44.99。
products.description: Documenting a workflow means screenshots, cropping, arrows, and typing out every step. StepGrab does it for you: hit record, do the task once, and every click comes back as an annotated screenshot with the step already written. Native Mac menu bar app, on-device, no account, nothing uploaded. Export as GIF, PDF, MP4, clickable HTML, Markdown, or vertical video — one recording, your brand color. Free tier is real. Pro $2.99/mo, $12.99/yr, or $44.99 once.

products.name: npm i -g hotcell
products.tagline: Local sandboxes for AI agents on your Mac, Linux, bare metal
products.summaryZh: 在Mac、Linux、裸金属上为AI代理提供本地沙箱。
products.descriptionZh: 自托管沙箱SDK，灵感源自Cloudflare Sandbox SDK。适用于任何设备（Mac、Linux、裸机）。使用极其简便（无论是人类工程师还是智能体）。您可完全控制每个沙箱的容量/令牌消耗，可默认拒绝出站流量，同时仍允许访问LLM提供商，且API密钥从不直接进入每个沙箱（而是创建随沙箱停止而失效的按沙箱令牌）。npm i -g hotcell
products.description: Self-hostable sandbox SDK inspired by Cloudflare Sandbox SDK. works on any device (Mac, Linux, bare metal). super easy to use (both by human engineers and agents). you get full control over capacity/token spent per sandbox, you can default-deny egress but still allow access to LLM providers, and API keys never directly enter each sandbox (it creates per-sandbox tokens instead that die when the sandbox stops). npm i -g hotcell

products.name: Keytones
products.tagline: Distinct key sounds for uppercase, lowercase & more
products.summaryZh: 为大写、小写及其他情况提供独特的按键音
products.descriptionZh: 是否曾在大写锁定状态下打完一整句话才察觉？Keytones为每组按键（大写、小写、空格键及修饰键）播放独特声音，让耳朵先于眼睛捕捉误触的Caps Lock。可分别调节每组按键的音高、时长、阻尼及音量，导入自定义声音，或若声音反馈不可行，可开启视觉反馈：屏幕边缘随每次按键闪烁发光。支持按应用控制、Siri与快捷指令，以及三击快速静音。一次购买，无需订阅。
products.description: Ever typed a whole sentence in caps before noticing? Keytones plays a distinct sound for each key group (uppercase, lowercase, space bar, and modifiers) so your ears catch a stray Caps Lock before your eyes do. Tune Pitch, Length, Damping + Volume per group, import your own sounds, or, if audible feedback isn't an option, turn on Visual Feedback: a glowing screen edge that pulses with every keystroke. Per-app control, Siri + Shortcuts, instant triple-tap mute. One-time purchase, no subscription.

products.name: Hansel
products.tagline: Remember everything you've worked on
products.summaryZh: 记住你所有的工作成果
products.descriptionZh: Hansel 帮助你记住工作内容、查找过往上下文，并解答关于工作日的问题。你的数据在 Mac 上保持加密。
products.description: Hansel helps you remember what you worked on, find past context, and answer questions about your workday. Your data stays encrypted on your Mac.

products.name: Aegisora
products.tagline: The narrow control plane for AI agent tool and API calls.
products.summaryZh: 面向AI代理工具与API调用的窄控制平面。
products.descriptionZh: 别再兜售抽象的“AI安全”了。企业购买的是运营控制权。Aegisora是一个为AppSec团队打造的开源、零延迟代理层。拦截恶意LLM行为，强制最小权限API访问，实时屏蔽PII，并为自主代理生成可读的审计日志——无需臃肿的中间件。
products.description: Stop selling abstract "AI safety". Enterprises buy operational control. Aegisora is an open-source, zero-latency proxy layer built for AppSec teams. Intercept malicious LLM actions, enforce least-privilege API access, mask PII on the fly, and generate readable audit logs for autonomous agents—without the bloated middleware.

products.name: GenMotion
products.tagline: Create beautiful product launch videos using AI
products.summaryZh: 使用AI制作精美的产品发布视频
products.descriptionZh: 用AI生成产品发布视频。用平实的语言描述你的产品，GenMotion的智能体会创建精美的动画、真实场景，逐帧精确预览，并导出像素级完美的MP4文件。
products.description: Generate a product launch video with AI. Describe your product in plain language and GenMotion's agent creates beautiful animations, real scenes, previews it frame-accurately, and exports a pixel-perfect MP4.

products.name: AppScout
products.tagline: App Store downloads, revenue & widgets
products.summaryZh: App Store下载量、收入与小组件
products.descriptionZh: 无需打开App Store Connect，即可查看App Store数据。AppScout在桌面和锁屏小组件中展示下载量、收入、MRR等数据。在应用内，通过详细图表、分类视图、多应用视图和筛选功能深入分析。无需登录，只需添加App Store Connect密钥，AppScout便直接从Apple获取报告。密钥不会离开你的iPhone。AppScout无后端、无追踪、无数据收集，你的凭据和报告始终私密保存在设备上。
products.description: See your App Store numbers without opening App Store Connect. AppScout shows downloads, revenue, MRR, and more in Home and Lock screen widgets. Dive deeper with detailed charts, breakdowns, multi-app views, and filters in the app. There’s no sign-in. Just add your App Store Connect key, and AppScout fetches the reports directly from Apple. The key never leaves your iPhone. AppScout has no backend, tracking, or data collection. Your credentials and reports stay private on your device.

products.name: JustInterview.ai
products.tagline: Hire 20× Faster. Fill Roles in Days, Not Weeks
products.summaryZh: 招聘速度提升20倍。数日内填补职位空缺，而非数周。
products.descriptionZh: 在JustInterview.ai上，您可以通过AI面试、编程评估、多选题测试、Vibe Coding挑战以及针对特定岗位的技能评估来考察候选人，同时自动化招聘的每个阶段。创建职位描述、即时筛选简历、管理校园招聘、与招聘团队协作、生成录用通知书，并从一个统一平台做出更快速、数据驱动的招聘决策。我们的愿景很简单：只要有面试，就应该在JustInterview.ai上进行。
products.description: On JustInterview.ai you can evaluate candidates through AI Interviews, Coding Assessments, MCQ Tests, Vibe Coding Challenges, and role-specific skill evaluations, while automating every stage of recruitment. Create job descriptions, screen resumes instantly, manage campus drives, collaborate with hiring teams, generate offer letters, and make faster, data-driven hiring decisions from one unified platform. Our vision is simple: if there's an interview, it should happen on JustInterview.ai.

products.name: Yondry
products.tagline: Turn your Instagram saves into actual day plans
products.summaryZh: 将你的Instagram收藏转化为实际日程安排
products.descriptionZh: 你已收藏400个地点，却只去过6个。Yondry解决这个问题：分享任意帖子或链接，它会提取真实地点，AI规划师根据你的收藏安排一天行程——考虑天气、限定时间、可随时调整。适合一日出游，而非长途旅行。去远方吧。
products.description: You've saved 400 places and visited 6. Yondry fixes that: share any post or link, it extracts the real place, and an AI planner builds your day around YOUR saves — weather-aware, time-boxed, swap anything. For days out, not trips. Go yonder.

products.name: NextDoor.Company
products.tagline: Discover startups hiring near you, on a map
products.summaryZh: 在地图上发现附近正在招聘的初创公司
products.descriptionZh: 在地图上发现你附近正在招聘的初创公司。全球400多家手工精选初创企业，每周更新超过16,000个实时职位空缺。按工作模式筛选：远程、混合或现场办公。查看融资、估值和营收详情，经过验证的创始人简介、主要投资者及其投资细节，全部集中在一处。
products.description: Find startups hiring near you, on a map. 400+ hand curated startups globally, 16,000+ live job openings updated weekly. Filter by work mode: remote, hybrid, or on site. See funding, valuation, and revenue details, verified founder profiles, key investors, and their investment details, all in one place.

products.name: X Money
products.tagline: Your money, on the world's most powerful network.
products.summaryZh: 你的资金，运行在全球最强大的网络上。
products.descriptionZh: 一个应用，涵盖金钱所能及的一切：赚取行业领先的APY，使用X Card获得现金返还，并在X上即时转账。
products.description: One app, everything money can do: earn industry-leading APY, get cashback with the X Card, and send money instantly on X.
